# ============================================================
# Cell 2:
# B16.0 core experiment
# Compare memory-feedback, history-only, fast-forgetting, and no-memory cases.
# ============================================================

scenario_specs = [
    {
        "scenario_name": "memory_feedback",
        "memory_enabled": True,
        "feedback_enabled": True,
        "alpha": 0.015,
        "etaS": 8.0,
        "beta": 3.0,
    },
    {
        "scenario_name": "history_no_feedback",
        "memory_enabled": True,
        "feedback_enabled": False,
        "alpha": 0.015,
        "etaS": 0.0,
        "beta": 3.0,
    },
    {
        "scenario_name": "fast_forgetting_feedback",
        "memory_enabled": True,
        "feedback_enabled": True,
        "alpha": 0.20,
        "etaS": 8.0,
        "beta": 3.0,
    },
    {
        "scenario_name": "no_memory",
        "memory_enabled": False,
        "feedback_enabled": True,
        "alpha": 0.015,
        "etaS": 8.0,
        "beta": 0.0,
    },
]

trajectory_frames = []
profile_frames = []
metrics_rows = []
params_records = []

for spec in scenario_specs:
    print("Running scenario:", spec["scenario_name"])

    traj, prof, met, params = run_b16_memory_free_boundary(**spec)

    trajectory_frames.append(traj)
    profile_frames.append(prof)
    metrics_rows.append(met)
    params_records.append(params)

trajectory_df = pd.concat(trajectory_frames, ignore_index=True)
profile_df = pd.concat(profile_frames, ignore_index=True)
metrics_df = pd.DataFrame(metrics_rows)

save_csv(trajectory_df, "B16_0_core_trajectories.csv")
save_csv(profile_df, "B16_0_core_profiles.csv")
save_csv(metrics_df, "B16_0_core_metrics.csv")

summary = {
    "experiment": "B16_0_memory_bearing_free_boundary_core",
    "description": (
        "Reduced 1D free-boundary field coupled to a boundary-history field. "
        "A localized pulse writes history near the threshold boundary; retained history may feed back "
        "on later source susceptibility and decay."
    ),
    "key_metrics": metrics_df.to_dict(orient="records"),
    "interpretation": (
        "This core experiment tests whether a moving threshold boundary can carry a history trace, "
        "whether that trace persists after stimulus removal, and whether it alters later local response "
        "or boundary trajectory. It is a proof-of-concept model, not a biological or quantum derivation."
    ),
    "params": params_records,
}

save_json(summary, "B16_0_core_summary.json")

display(metrics_df)

# ============================================================
# Cell 3:
# B16.0 core figures
# ============================================================

plt.figure(figsize=(8.5, 5.2))
for scenario in metrics_df["scenario"]:
    sub = trajectory_df[trajectory_df["scenario"] == scenario]
    plt.plot(sub["t_main"], sub["R_right"], label=scenario)

plt.axvspan(2.0, 5.0, alpha=0.15, label="pulse 1")
plt.axvspan(16.0, 19.0, alpha=0.15, label="pulse 2")
plt.xlabel("main time")
plt.ylabel("right boundary location R(t)")
plt.title("B16.0 memory-bearing free boundary: boundary trajectory")
plt.legend()
save_figure("B16_0_right_boundary_trajectories.png")


plt.figure(figsize=(8.5, 5.2))
for scenario in metrics_df["scenario"]:
    sub = trajectory_df[trajectory_df["scenario"] == scenario]
    plt.plot(sub["t_main"], sub["m_at_stim"], label=scenario)

plt.axvspan(2.0, 5.0, alpha=0.15, label="pulse 1")
plt.axvspan(16.0, 19.0, alpha=0.15, label="pulse 2")
plt.xlabel("main time")
plt.ylabel("history m near stimulated boundary")
plt.title("B16.0 boundary history written and retained near moving boundary")
plt.legend()
save_figure("B16_0_history_at_stimulus_site.png")


plt.figure(figsize=(8.5, 5.2))
for scenario in metrics_df["scenario"]:
    sub = trajectory_df[trajectory_df["scenario"] == scenario]
    plt.plot(sub["t_main"], sub["phi_at_stim"], label=scenario)

plt.axvspan(2.0, 5.0, alpha=0.15, label="pulse 1")
plt.axvspan(16.0, 19.0, alpha=0.15, label="pulse 2")
plt.xlabel("main time")
plt.ylabel("phi at stimulated boundary site")
plt.title("B16.0 local boundary response after retained history")
plt.legend()
save_figure("B16_0_phi_response_at_stimulus_site.png")


plt.figure(figsize=(8.5, 5.2))
plot_df = metrics_df.copy()
plt.bar(plot_df["scenario"], plot_df["persistent_boundary_offset"])
plt.ylabel("R_before_pulse2 - R_before_pulse1")
plt.title("B16.0 persistent boundary offset after first stimulation")
plt.xticks(rotation=25, ha="right")
save_figure("B16_0_persistent_boundary_offset.png")


plt.figure(figsize=(8.5, 5.2))
plot_df = metrics_df.copy()
plt.bar(plot_df["scenario"], plot_df["phi_probe_increment_pulse2"])
plt.ylabel("pulse-2 increment of phi at stimulated site")
plt.title("B16.0 later local response at trained boundary site")
plt.xticks(rotation=25, ha="right")
save_figure("B16_0_pulse2_local_response_increment.png")


# Final profiles for phi and m
final_profiles = profile_df[profile_df["label"] == "final"]

plt.figure(figsize=(8.5, 5.2))
for scenario in metrics_df["scenario"]:
    sub = final_profiles[final_profiles["scenario"] == scenario]
    plt.plot(sub["x"], sub["phi"], label=scenario)

plt.axhline(0.030, linestyle="--", linewidth=1.0, label="boundary threshold")
plt.xlabel("x")
plt.ylabel("phi(x)")
plt.title("B16.0 final free-boundary field profiles")
plt.legend()
save_figure("B16_0_final_phi_profiles.png")


plt.figure(figsize=(8.5, 5.2))
for scenario in metrics_df["scenario"]:
    sub = final_profiles[final_profiles["scenario"] == scenario]
    plt.plot(sub["x"], sub["m"], label=scenario)

plt.xlabel("x")
plt.ylabel("m(x)")
plt.title("B16.0 final boundary-history profiles")
plt.legend()
save_figure("B16_0_final_history_profiles.png")

# ============================================================
# Cell 4:
# B16.1 parameter scan
# Forgetting rate alpha × history-feedback strength etaS
# ============================================================

alpha_values = [0.010, 0.030, 0.080, 0.200]
etaS_values = [0.0, 3.0, 6.0, 10.0]

scan_rows = []

for alpha in alpha_values:
    for etaS in etaS_values:
        scenario_name = f"scan_alpha_{alpha:.3f}_etaS_{etaS:.1f}"

        print("Running scan:", scenario_name)

        traj, prof, met, params = run_b16_memory_free_boundary(
            scenario_name=scenario_name,
            memory_enabled=True,
            feedback_enabled=(etaS > 0.0),
            alpha=alpha,
            etaS=etaS,
            beta=3.0,
            N=320,
            record_every=40,
            store_profile_times=(26.0,),
        )

        met["alpha"] = float(alpha)
        met["etaS"] = float(etaS)

        scan_rows.append(met)

scan_df = pd.DataFrame(scan_rows)

save_csv(scan_df, "B16_1_alpha_etaS_parameter_scan.csv")

scan_summary = {
    "experiment": "B16_1_alpha_etaS_parameter_scan",
    "description": (
        "Parameter scan over forgetting rate alpha and history-feedback strength etaS. "
        "Metrics track retained history near the stimulated boundary, persistent boundary offset, "
        "and later local response."
    ),
    "alpha_values": alpha_values,
    "etaS_values": etaS_values,
    "results": scan_df.to_dict(orient="records"),
}

save_json(scan_summary, "B16_1_alpha_etaS_parameter_scan_summary.json")

display(scan_df)

# ============================================================
# Cell 5:
# B16.1 scan figures
# ============================================================

def plot_heatmap_from_scan(df, value_col, filename, title, cmap=None):
    pivot = df.pivot(index="alpha", columns="etaS", values=value_col)
    alpha_axis = pivot.index.to_numpy(dtype=float)
    eta_axis = pivot.columns.to_numpy(dtype=float)

    plt.figure(figsize=(7.0, 5.4))
    plt.imshow(
        pivot.to_numpy(),
        origin="lower",
        aspect="auto",
        extent=[
            float(np.min(eta_axis)),
            float(np.max(eta_axis)),
            float(np.min(alpha_axis)),
            float(np.max(alpha_axis)),
        ],
    )
    plt.colorbar(label=value_col)
    plt.xlabel("history-feedback strength etaS")
    plt.ylabel("forgetting rate alpha")
    plt.title(title)
    save_figure(filename)


plot_heatmap_from_scan(
    scan_df,
    "m_at_stim_before_pulse2",
    "B16_1_scan_retained_history_heatmap.png",
    "B16.1 retained history before second pulse",
)

plot_heatmap_from_scan(
    scan_df,
    "persistent_boundary_offset",
    "B16_1_scan_persistent_boundary_offset_heatmap.png",
    "B16.1 persistent boundary offset",
)

plot_heatmap_from_scan(
    scan_df,
    "phi_probe_increment_pulse2",
    "B16_1_scan_later_local_response_heatmap.png",
    "B16.1 later local response increment",
)


plt.figure(figsize=(8.0, 5.2))
for etaS in etaS_values:
    sub = scan_df[scan_df["etaS"] == etaS]
    plt.plot(
        sub["alpha"],
        sub["m_at_stim_before_pulse2"],
        marker="o",
        label=f"etaS={etaS}",
    )

plt.xlabel("forgetting rate alpha")
plt.ylabel("m at stimulated site before pulse 2")
plt.title("B16.1 forgetting controls retained boundary history")
plt.legend()
save_figure("B16_1_retained_history_vs_alpha.png")


plt.figure(figsize=(8.0, 5.2))
for alpha in alpha_values:
    sub = scan_df[scan_df["alpha"] == alpha]
    plt.plot(
        sub["etaS"],
        sub["persistent_boundary_offset"],
        marker="o",
        label=f"alpha={alpha}",
    )

plt.xlabel("history-feedback strength etaS")
plt.ylabel("persistent boundary offset")
plt.title("B16.1 feedback controls boundary persistence")
plt.legend()
save_figure("B16_1_boundary_offset_vs_feedback.png")

# ============================================================
# Cell 2:
# B16.2 intervention scan
# kept-history branch vs erased-history branch
# ============================================================

alpha_values = [0.010, 0.030, 0.080, 0.200]
etaS_values = [0.0, 3.0, 6.0, 10.0]

trajectory_frames = []
metrics_rows = []
pair_rows = []

for alpha in alpha_values:
    print("Creating prehistory state for alpha =", alpha)

    state = create_prehistory_state(
        alpha=alpha,
        N=384,
        dt=0.002,
        t_probe_start=16.0,
    )

    for etaS in etaS_values:
        print("  Probe etaS =", etaS)

        traj_keep, met_keep = run_probe_from_state(
            state,
            alpha=alpha,
            etaS=etaS,
            erase_memory=False,
            branch_name="kept_history",
            etaMu=0.0,
            write_second_pulse=False,
        )

        traj_erase, met_erase = run_probe_from_state(
            state,
            alpha=alpha,
            etaS=etaS,
            erase_memory=True,
            branch_name="erased_history",
            etaMu=0.0,
            write_second_pulse=False,
        )

        trajectory_frames.append(traj_keep)
        trajectory_frames.append(traj_erase)
        metrics_rows.append(met_keep)
        metrics_rows.append(met_erase)

        pair_rows.append({
            "alpha": float(alpha),
            "etaS": float(etaS),
            "retained_m_at_stim": float(met_keep["m_at_stim_probe_start"]),
            "erased_m_at_stim": float(met_erase["m_at_stim_probe_start"]),
            "effective_feedback_load": float(etaS * met_keep["m_at_stim_probe_start"]),
            "phi_increment_kept": float(met_keep["phi_increment_probe"]),
            "phi_increment_erased": float(met_erase["phi_increment_probe"]),
            "adaptive_phi_delta": float(
                met_keep["phi_increment_probe"] - met_erase["phi_increment_probe"]
            ),
            "adaptive_phi_ratio": float(
                met_keep["phi_increment_probe"] / (met_erase["phi_increment_probe"] + 1e-15)
            ),
            "R_increment_kept": float(met_keep["R_increment_probe"]),
            "R_increment_erased": float(met_erase["R_increment_probe"]),
            "adaptive_R_delta": float(
                met_keep["R_increment_probe"] - met_erase["R_increment_probe"]
            ),
        })

trajectory_df = pd.concat(trajectory_frames, ignore_index=True)
metrics_df = pd.DataFrame(metrics_rows)
pair_df = pd.DataFrame(pair_rows)

save_csv(trajectory_df, "B16_2_intervention_trajectories.csv")
save_csv(metrics_df, "B16_2_intervention_branch_metrics.csv")
save_csv(pair_df, "B16_2_intervention_pair_metrics.csv")

summary = {
    "experiment": "B16_2_late_feedback_intervention",
    "description": (
        "Pulse 1 writes boundary history while feedback is disabled. "
        "Before pulse 2, the same prehistory state is branched into kept-history and erased-history cases. "
        "Pulse 2 tests the direct effect of retained history on local boundary response."
    ),
    "alpha_values": alpha_values,
    "etaS_values": etaS_values,
    "etaMu": 0.0,
    "write_second_pulse": False,
    "interpretation": (
        "Because phi is matched at the branch point, kept-minus-erased response isolates the effect of retained m "
        "during the second stimulus. etaS=0 is an exact no-feedback control in this intervention scan."
    ),
    "results": pair_df.to_dict(orient="records"),
}

save_json(summary, "B16_2_intervention_summary.json")

display(pair_df)

# ============================================================
# Cell 3:
# B16.2 intervention figures
# ============================================================

def plot_heatmap(df, value_col, filename, title):
    pivot = df.pivot(index="alpha", columns="etaS", values=value_col)
    alpha_axis = pivot.index.to_numpy(dtype=float)
    eta_axis = pivot.columns.to_numpy(dtype=float)

    plt.figure(figsize=(7.2, 5.4))
    plt.imshow(
        pivot.to_numpy(),
        origin="lower",
        aspect="auto",
        extent=[
            float(np.min(eta_axis)),
            float(np.max(eta_axis)),
            float(np.min(alpha_axis)),
            float(np.max(alpha_axis)),
        ],
    )
    plt.colorbar(label=value_col)
    plt.xlabel("history-feedback strength etaS")
    plt.ylabel("forgetting rate alpha")
    plt.title(title)
    save_figure(filename)


plot_heatmap(
    pair_df,
    "adaptive_phi_delta",
    "B16_2_adaptive_phi_delta_heatmap.png",
    "B16.2 retained-history contribution to local response",
)

plot_heatmap(
    pair_df,
    "adaptive_phi_ratio",
    "B16_2_adaptive_phi_ratio_heatmap.png",
    "B16.2 kept/erased local response ratio",
)

plot_heatmap(
    pair_df,
    "adaptive_R_delta",
    "B16_2_adaptive_R_delta_heatmap.png",
    "B16.2 retained-history contribution to boundary movement",
)

plot_heatmap(
    pair_df,
    "retained_m_at_stim",
    "B16_2_retained_history_before_probe_heatmap.png",
    "B16.2 retained history before second pulse",
)


plt.figure(figsize=(8.0, 5.2))
for alpha in alpha_values:
    sub = pair_df[pair_df["alpha"] == alpha]
    plt.plot(
        sub["etaS"],
        sub["adaptive_phi_delta"],
        marker="o",
        label=f"alpha={alpha}",
    )

plt.xlabel("history-feedback strength etaS")
plt.ylabel("kept - erased local response increment")
plt.title("B16.2 adaptive response requires retained history and feedback")
plt.legend()
save_figure("B16_2_adaptive_phi_delta_vs_feedback.png")


plt.figure(figsize=(8.0, 5.2))
for etaS in etaS_values:
    sub = pair_df[pair_df["etaS"] == etaS]
    plt.plot(
        sub["alpha"],
        sub["adaptive_phi_delta"],
        marker="o",
        label=f"etaS={etaS}",
    )

plt.xlabel("forgetting rate alpha")
plt.ylabel("kept - erased local response increment")
plt.title("B16.2 forgetting suppresses adaptive response")
plt.legend()
save_figure("B16_2_adaptive_phi_delta_vs_alpha.png")


plt.figure(figsize=(7.2, 5.2))
sub = pair_df[pair_df["etaS"] > 0.0]
plt.scatter(sub["effective_feedback_load"], sub["adaptive_phi_delta"])
for _, row in sub.iterrows():
    plt.text(
        row["effective_feedback_load"],
        row["adaptive_phi_delta"],
        f"a={row['alpha']}, e={row['etaS']}",
        fontsize=8,
    )

plt.xlabel("effective feedback load etaS × retained m")
plt.ylabel("kept - erased local response increment")
plt.title("B16.2 response vs effective retained-history load")
save_figure("B16_2_response_vs_effective_feedback_load.png")


# Representative trajectories for strongest and weakest nonzero retained-history effects
representative_cases = [
    (0.010, 10.0),
    (0.200, 10.0),
]

for alpha, etaS in representative_cases:
    plt.figure(figsize=(8.5, 5.2))

    sub = trajectory_df[
        (np.isclose(trajectory_df["alpha"], alpha))
        & (np.isclose(trajectory_df["etaS"], etaS))
    ]

    for branch in ["kept_history", "erased_history"]:
        bsub = sub[sub["branch"] == branch]
        plt.plot(
            bsub["t"],
            bsub["phi_at_stim"],
            label=branch,
        )

    plt.axvspan(16.0, 19.0, alpha=0.15, label="pulse 2")
    plt.xlabel("time")
    plt.ylabel("phi at stimulated boundary site")
    plt.title(f"B16.2 paired probe response: alpha={alpha}, etaS={etaS}")
    plt.legend()

    safe_alpha = str(alpha).replace(".", "p")
    safe_eta = str(etaS).replace(".", "p")
    save_figure(f"B16_2_paired_probe_alpha_{safe_alpha}_etaS_{safe_eta}.png")

# ============================================================
# Cell 2:
# B16.3 spatial shift scan
# ============================================================

alpha_values = [0.010, 0.030, 0.080, 0.200]
shift_values = [-1.00, -0.50, -0.25, 0.00, 0.25, 0.50, 1.00]
etaS_values = [0.0, 10.0]

trajectory_frames = []
metrics_rows = []
pair_rows = []

for alpha in alpha_values:
    print("Creating prehistory state for alpha =", alpha)

    state = create_prehistory_state(
        alpha=alpha,
        N=384,
        dt=0.002,
        t_probe_start=16.0,
    )

    for shift in shift_values:
        for etaS in etaS_values:
            print("  Probe shift =", shift, "etaS =", etaS)

            traj_keep, met_keep = run_shifted_probe(
                state,
                alpha=alpha,
                etaS=etaS,
                shift=shift,
                erase_memory=False,
                branch_name="kept_history",
                etaMu=0.0,
                write_second_pulse=False,
            )

            traj_erase, met_erase = run_shifted_probe(
                state,
                alpha=alpha,
                etaS=etaS,
                shift=shift,
                erase_memory=True,
                branch_name="erased_history",
                etaMu=0.0,
                write_second_pulse=False,
            )

            trajectory_frames.append(traj_keep)
            trajectory_frames.append(traj_erase)

            metrics_rows.append(met_keep)
            metrics_rows.append(met_erase)

            pair_rows.append({
                "alpha": float(alpha),
                "etaS": float(etaS),
                "shift": float(shift),
                "x_memory": float(met_keep["x_memory"]),
                "x_probe": float(met_keep["x_probe"]),
                "retained_m_at_probe": float(met_keep["retained_m_at_probe"]),
                "retained_m_at_memory_site": float(met_keep["retained_m_at_memory_site"]),
                "effective_feedback_load": float(met_keep["effective_feedback_load"]),
                "phi_increment_kept": float(met_keep["phi_increment_probe"]),
                "phi_increment_erased": float(met_erase["phi_increment_probe"]),
                "adaptive_phi_delta": float(
                    met_keep["phi_increment_probe"] - met_erase["phi_increment_probe"]
                ),
                "adaptive_phi_ratio": float(
                    met_keep["phi_increment_probe"] / (met_erase["phi_increment_probe"] + 1e-15)
                ),
                "R_increment_kept": float(met_keep["R_increment_probe"]),
                "R_increment_erased": float(met_erase["R_increment_probe"]),
                "adaptive_R_delta": float(
                    met_keep["R_increment_probe"] - met_erase["R_increment_probe"]
                ),
            })

trajectory_df = pd.concat(trajectory_frames, ignore_index=True)
metrics_df = pd.DataFrame(metrics_rows)
pair_df = pd.DataFrame(pair_rows)

save_csv(trajectory_df, "B16_3_spatial_locality_trajectories.csv")
save_csv(metrics_df, "B16_3_spatial_locality_branch_metrics.csv")
save_csv(pair_df, "B16_3_spatial_locality_pair_metrics.csv")

summary = {
    "experiment": "B16_3_spatial_locality_of_boundary_history_feedback",
    "description": (
        "A first boundary stimulus writes retained history near the moving threshold boundary. "
        "Before the second stimulus, the same prehistory state is branched into kept-history and erased-history cases. "
        "The second stimulus is shifted relative to the memory site to test spatial locality of the adaptive response."
    ),
    "alpha_values": alpha_values,
    "shift_values": shift_values,
    "etaS_values": etaS_values,
    "etaMu": 0.0,
    "write_second_pulse": False,
    "interpretation": (
        "If retained boundary history acts locally, kept-minus-erased response should be largest when the second stimulus overlaps "
        "the memory trace and should decrease as the second stimulus is shifted away. etaS=0 is an exact no-feedback control."
    ),
    "results": pair_df.to_dict(orient="records"),
}

save_json(summary, "B16_3_spatial_locality_summary.json")

display(pair_df)

# ============================================================
# Cell 3:
# B16.3 spatial locality figures
# ============================================================

nonzero_df = pair_df[pair_df["etaS"] > 0.0].copy()
zero_df = pair_df[pair_df["etaS"] == 0.0].copy()

plt.figure(figsize=(8.2, 5.2))
for alpha in alpha_values:
    sub = nonzero_df[np.isclose(nonzero_df["alpha"], alpha)]
    plt.plot(
        sub["shift"],
        sub["adaptive_phi_delta"],
        marker="o",
        label=f"alpha={alpha}",
    )

plt.axhline(0.0, linewidth=1.0)
plt.axvline(0.0, linestyle="--", linewidth=1.0, label="memory site")
plt.xlabel("second-stimulus shift from memory site")
plt.ylabel("kept - erased local response increment")
plt.title("B16.3 spatial locality of adaptive boundary response")
plt.legend()
save_figure("B16_3_adaptive_phi_delta_vs_shift.png")


plt.figure(figsize=(8.2, 5.2))
for alpha in alpha_values:
    sub = nonzero_df[np.isclose(nonzero_df["alpha"], alpha)]
    plt.plot(
        sub["shift"],
        sub["retained_m_at_probe"],
        marker="o",
        label=f"alpha={alpha}",
    )

plt.axvline(0.0, linestyle="--", linewidth=1.0, label="memory site")
plt.xlabel("second-stimulus shift from memory site")
plt.ylabel("retained m sampled by second stimulus")
plt.title("B16.3 retained history sampled by shifted stimulus")
plt.legend()
save_figure("B16_3_retained_m_at_probe_vs_shift.png")


plt.figure(figsize=(7.4, 5.2))
sub = nonzero_df.copy()
plt.scatter(sub["retained_m_at_probe"], sub["adaptive_phi_delta"])
for _, row in sub.iterrows():
    plt.text(
        row["retained_m_at_probe"],
        row["adaptive_phi_delta"],
        f"a={row['alpha']}, s={row['shift']}",
        fontsize=7,
    )

plt.xlabel("retained m sampled by second stimulus")
plt.ylabel("kept - erased local response increment")

robust_rows = []

for variant in variants:
    print("\nVariant:", variant["variant_name"])

    # Create each alpha prehistory once per variant.
    states_by_alpha = {}

    for alpha in sorted(set(t["alpha"] for t in tests)):
        print("  Creating prehistory alpha =", alpha)

        state = create_prehistory_state(
            alpha=alpha,
            N=variant["N"],
            L=variant["L"],
            dt=variant["dt"],
            T_pre=variant["T_pre"],
            t_probe_start=variant["t_probe_start"],
            D0=variant["D0"],

            phi_c=variant["phi_c"],
            gamma0=variant["gamma0"],
            mu0=variant["mu0"],
            base_amp=variant["base_amp"],
            base_width=variant["base_width"],
            stim_amp_1=variant["stim_amp_1"],
            stim_width=variant["stim_width"],
            stim_offset=variant["stim_offset"],
            phi_thr=variant["phi_thr"],
            phi_width=variant["phi_width"],
            beta=variant["beta"],
            Dm=variant["Dm"],
        )

        states_by_alpha[alpha] = state

        prehistory_rows.append({
            "variant_group": variant["variant_group"],
            "variant_name": variant["variant_name"],
            "alpha": float(alpha),
            "N": int(variant["N"]),
            "dt": float(variant["dt"]),
            "Dm": float(variant["Dm"]),
            "stim_width": float(variant["stim_width"]),
            "phi_width": float(variant["phi_width"]),
            "R_initial": float(state["R_initial"]),
            "R_probe": float(state["R_probe"]),
            "boundary_advance_before_probe": float(state["R_probe"] - state["R_initial"]),
            "x_memory": float(state["x_memory"]),
            "y_memory_branch": float(state["x_memory"] - state["R_probe"]),
            "x_m_peak": float(state["x_m_peak"]),
            "y_m_peak": float(state["y_m_peak"]),
            "x_m_center": float(state["x_m_center"]),
            "y_m_center": float(state["y_m_center"]),
            "m_peak": float(state["m_peak"]),
            "m_total": float(state["m_total"]),
        })

    for test in tests:
        alpha = test["alpha"]
        etaS = test["etaS"]
        shift = test["shift"]

        print("  Running test:", test["test_name"])

        state = states_by_alpha[alpha]

        result = run_probe_pair(
            state,
            alpha=alpha,
            etaS=etaS,
            shift=shift,
            dt=variant["dt"],
            t_probe_start=variant["t_probe_start"],
            t_probe_end=variant["t_probe_end"],
            stim_amp_2=variant["stim_amp_2"],
            stim_width_2=variant["stim_width_2"],
            phi_thr=variant["phi_thr"],
            Dm=variant["Dm"],
            etaMu=0.0,
            write_second_pulse=False,
            beta=variant["beta"],
            phi_width=variant["phi_width"],
        )

        robust_rows.append({
            "variant_group": variant["variant_group"],
            "variant_name": variant["variant_name"],
            "test_name": test["test_name"],
            "alpha": float(alpha),
            "etaS": float(etaS),
            "shift": float(shift),
            "N": int(variant["N"]),
            "dt": float(variant["dt"]),
            "Dm": float(variant["Dm"]),
            "stim_width": float(variant["stim_width"]),
            "stim_width_2": float(variant["stim_width_2"]),
            "phi_width": float(variant["phi_width"]),
            "R_initial": float(state["R_initial"]),
            "R_probe": float(state["R_probe"]),
            "x_memory": float(state["x_memory"]),
            "y_memory_branch": float(state["x_memory"] - state["R_probe"]),
            "x_m_peak": float(state["x_m_peak"]),
            "y_m_peak": float(state["y_m_peak"]),
            "x_m_center": float(state["x_m_center"]),
            "y_m_center": float(state["y_m_center"]),
            **result,
        })

robust_df = pd.DataFrame(robust_rows)
prehistory_df = pd.DataFrame(prehistory_rows)

# Add normalized metrics relative to the baseline low-forgetting/high-feedback result.

    robust_df[

)

# Cell 5:
# Quantitative robustness diagnostics
# ============================================================

diagnostic_rows = []

low_df = robust_df[robust_df["test_name"] == "low_forgetting_high_feedback"].copy()
fast_df = robust_df[robust_df["test_name"] == "fast_forgetting_high_feedback"].copy()
control_df = robust_df[robust_df["test_name"] == "low_forgetting_no_feedback_control"].copy()

for group in sorted(robust_df["variant_group"].unique()):
    g_low = low_df[low_df["variant_group"] == group]
    g_fast = fast_df[fast_df["variant_group"] == group]
    g_control = control_df[control_df["variant_group"] == group]

    diagnostic_rows.append({
        "variant_group": group,
        "num_variants": int(len(g_low)),
        "low_min_adaptive_phi_delta": float(g_low["adaptive_phi_delta"].min()),
        "low_max_adaptive_phi_delta": float(g_low["adaptive_phi_delta"].max()),
        "low_mean_adaptive_phi_delta": float(g_low["adaptive_phi_delta"].mean()),
        "fast_max_adaptive_phi_delta": float(g_fast["adaptive_phi_delta"].max()),
        "fast_mean_adaptive_phi_delta": float(g_fast["adaptive_phi_delta"].mean()),
        "max_abs_no_feedback_control_delta": float(np.max(np.abs(g_control["adaptive_phi_delta"].to_numpy()))),
        "min_low_over_fast_ratio": float(
            np.min(
                g_low["adaptive_phi_delta"].to_numpy()
                / (g_fast["adaptive_phi_delta"].to_numpy() + 1e-15)
            )
        ),
    })

diagnostics_df = pd.DataFrame(diagnostic_rows)

# Global fit: adaptive response vs effective retained-history load.
sub = robust_df[robust_df["etaS"] > 0.0].copy()
x = sub["effective_feedback_load"].to_numpy(dtype=float)
y = sub["adaptive_phi_delta"].to_numpy(dtype=float)

if len(x) >= 2 and np.std(x) > 1e-15:
    A = np.vstack([x, np.ones_like(x)]).T
    slope, intercept = np.linalg.lstsq(A, y, rcond=None)[0]
    yhat = slope * x + intercept
    ss_res = float(np.sum((y - yhat) ** 2))
    ss_tot = float(np.sum((y - np.mean(y)) ** 2))
    r2 = 1.0 - ss_res / (ss_tot + 1e-15)
    corr = float(np.corrcoef(x, y)[0, 1])
else:
    slope = np.nan
    intercept = np.nan
    r2 = np.nan
    corr = np.nan

fit_df = pd.DataFrame([{
    "fit": "adaptive_phi_delta_vs_effective_feedback_load_all_robustness_variants",
    "slope": float(slope),
    "intercept": float(intercept),
    "r2": float(r2),
    "corr": float(corr),
}])

save_csv(diagnostics_df, "B16_5_robustness_group_diagnostics.csv")
save_csv(fit_df, "B16_5_robustness_fit_diagnostics.csv")

diagnostic_summary = {
    "experiment": "B16_5_robustness_diagnostics",

    "fit_diagnostics": fit_df.to_dict(orient="records"),
    "interpretation": (
        "The robustness result should be considered strong if the low-forgetting/high-feedback adaptive response "
        "remains positive across variants, fast forgetting suppresses the response, no-feedback controls remain near zero, "
        "and adaptive response continues to scale with effective retained-history load."
    ),
}
